$comment: The phone screenshots for Play, in listing order. Each is a real capture of the app's own screen (raw/<id>.png), framed with the caption below by templates/frame.html. Every claim here must be one docs/aso/FEATURE_AUDIT.md marks Implemented. Run `bun run store:shots` in mobile/ to rebuild, then `bun run store:check`.

shots.title: Today’s gold rate, as the shop sets it
shots.urdu: آج کا سونے کا ریٹ، دکان کے بورڈ سے
shots.sub: 24K, 23.65K and 22K gold and silver, per tola and per gram

shots.title: What is my gold worth?
shots.urdu: میرے سونے کی قیمت کتنی ہے؟
shots.sub: Enter a weight in grams or tola, pick a purity, see the value

shots.title: Hallmarked jewellery, priced at today's rate
shots.urdu: ہال مارک زیورات، آج کے ریٹ پر
shots.sub: Browse by collection, or search by karat or piece number

shots.title: Keep the pieces you love
shots.sub: Your saved pieces stay on the phone and open without a signal

shots.title: Selling gold? See the buying rate first
shots.urdu: سونا بیچنا ہے؟ پہلے آج کا خرید ریٹ دیکھیں
shots.sub: Tested and weighed in front of you, with no obligation to sell

shots.title: Have a piece made for you
shots.sub: Send a photo, a description or a voice note to the workshop

shots.title: World gold, silver and the dollar
shots.urdu: عالمی سونا، چاندی اور ڈالر کا ریٹ
shots.sub: International prices beside the shop's own board

shots.title: Prices in your currency too
shots.urdu: قیمت اپنی کرنسی میں بھی دیکھیں
shots.sub: Rupees, with dollars, pounds, dirhams, riyals and more
